Coram : A.S. BOPANNA, C.T. RAVIKUMAR
Citizenship Act, 1955 – s.7B(1) – Through notifications dtd.11.04.2005, 05.01.2009, the Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders were given the right of parity with Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) in respect of the facilities as notified, including in the field of education, who in – Impugned notification dtd.04.03.21 issued by Respondent No.1, in exercise of powers u/s.7B(1), took away the existing right of OCI Cardholders of appearing for the Entrance Exams to compete with Indian Citizens for the seats and restricted the admission only as against the seats reserved
Decision Date : 03-02-2023 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 891/2021 | Disposal Nature : Case Partly allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
